desc: 瓷白拱龛雾紫台棚拍的蛋形罩盖宽口奶瓶，十屏漏斗式详情
leaf: 蛋形透明罩盖宽口径磨砂玻璃感奶瓶
name: 藕紫拱龛蛋形罩盖宽口奶瓶款

shots.intent: 用瓷白拱龛与雾紫台座一次交代蛋形透明罩盖、玫粉宽瓶盖环与磨砂白瓶身的整体轮廓，抢首屏停留与点击
shots.textZone: 上部三分之一留白带放一条中文主标（其中一个关键词下垫一条鸢尾紫高亮带）与一行小字副标，主标前一枚实心小方块点

shots.intent: 第二屏就用同款多色前后错落撑起货架感与停留，选款条目留空由卖家自填
shots.textZone: 五支下方各一枚空白圆角矩形标签胶囊，顶部一条选款小标题带一个高亮关键词

shots.intent: 把源图的一串两色分栏条改造成买家疑问清单，左图右题全部留空占位，避免功效断言
shots.textZone: 每条右半放一行小标题与一段留白，条目文字全部占位，左半为空白图位

shots.intent: 复刻源图白卡四图标版式，把四个卖点条目全部交给占位符并附一条空白品牌故事带
shots.textZone: 卡内顶部一行标题与一枚空白胶囊标签，下方四枚方格图章各带一条空白标签，底部一条空白细线故事带

shots.intent: 保留源图对比图的版式骨架但把轴向、条目与数值全部留空，卖家自填以免虚构年限与次数对比
shots.textZone: 卡顶一行对照标题，左侧三行空白条目胶囊，底部两枚色块图例不带文字

shots.intent: 仰视微距交代罩盖、宽瓶盖环与瓶口内结构的装配关系，三枚空白标签胶囊承接结构条目
shots.textZone: 上方一枚空白标签胶囊，左右各一枚空白标签胶囊，条目文字全部占位

shots.intent: 放进中性光的居家喂哺语境让买家代入，成人从肩下取景、婴儿只留背影且全程被托抱
以正侧面交代钟形磨砂瓶身与圆弧底座，三枚虚线剖面环带把结构条目交给占位符
shots.textZone: 右侧三枚方格图章各带一条空白标签，顶部一条结构小标题

shots.intent: 复刻详情页产品信息两栏档案与尺寸示意，字段与数值全部留空，杜绝参数材质杜撰
shots.textZone: 左上一节标题带方块点与细线，其下四行空白档案条目，字段名与数值全部占位

shots.intent: 用四枚斜置顶盖对角围合的源图版式收口，中心留出行动位，引导语全部交给占位符
shots.textZone: 中心留白带放结束标题、一枚空白行动按钮与两枚空白方格徽标，四角为斜置顶盖裁切图

style.backgroundSystem: a chalky limewash porcelain-lilac #F3F1F5 studio wall carrying one shallow arched niche cut directly behind the product, the bottle standing on a matte dusty-lavender #DCD6E7 slab plinth with a crisp 90-degree top edge and a hairline shadow under the plinth itself; every screen is inset with a slim double-rule iris-violet #8A72AE keyline frame; no podium discs, no sphere clusters, no wave ridges, no gradient cards, no coral or aqua fields, never a dark, wood or metallic surface
style.direction: chalky porcelain-lilac maternal-infant feeding bottle commerce
style.iconSystem: single-weight outline icons drawn inside rounded-square squircle chips keyed in iris violet #8A72AE, one chip size only across the whole set, glyph drawn in outline rather than knocked out; callouts drawn as one dashed square-chain leader ending in a small filled square and sitting inside a rounded-rectangle outline label pill; no solid filled circular stamps, no thin circular medallions, no second chip size and no second line weight
style.lightingSystem: broad frontal overhead key: one large softbox placed high and directly on the camera axis so the light spills straight downward, balanced by a neutral-lilac bounce card low at camera right; the shadow falls short and almost directly under the rounded base, contrast stays medium-low, the frosted body shows a soft even gradient rather than a hot highlight, and the clear dome keeps one thin clean specular along its crest; about 5200K neutral throughout, never a warm coral cast and never a cool aqua cast
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent chalky porcelain-lilac maternal-infant feeding bottle commerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of porcelain lilac-white base #F3F1F5 and dusty lavender secondary field #DCD6E7 with one iris-violet accent #8A72AE, one lotus-dust tint #E6D9DF and deep ink-plum text #3B3444; neutral daylight tone at about 5200K throughout; background system limited to a chalky limewash porcelain-lilac studio wall with one shallow arched niche cut behind the product and a matte dusty-lavender slab plinth with a crisp top edge, every screen inset with a slim double-rule iris-violet keyline frame, never a coral, aqua, mint, dark, wood or metallic field and no podium discs, no sphere clusters, no wave ridges and no gradient cards; broad frontal overhead softbox key placed on the camera axis spilling straight downward with a neutral-lilac bounce card low at camera right, one short contact shadow falling almost directly under the rounded base, one thin clean specular along the dome crest, medium-low contrast, about 5200K; matte limewash slab with a fine chalky tooth and refracted dome edges and no mirror reflection; one modern light-to-medium Chinese sans family with a single short headline in deep ink-plum #3B3444 carrying one soft iris-violet #8A72AE highlighter band behind exactly one keyword, one small filled square bullet plus one full-width hairline rule at every section title and one right-aligned three-dot pagination marker, no Latin overprint and no dense body text; single-weight outline icons drawn inside rounded-square squircle chips keyed in iris violet #8A72AE at one chip size only, callouts drawn as a dashed square-chain leader ending in a small filled square inside a rounded-rectangle outline label pill, no solid circular stamps and no thin circular medallions; the bottle stands upright at a stable scale inside the arched niche with the tall clear egg-shaped dome fitted, the wide collar ring closed and the teat seated inside the dome, bell-shaped frosted body, smoky grey-brown shoulder band under the collar ring, lilac vent disc beneath the teat flange, original dome height and shoulder flare, any graduation marking kept exactly as shot and any label area left as one blank legible field; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no dark scenes, no new product colors, no invented numbers.
noDrift: no medical or therapeutic benefit wording at all: no 「防胀气」, no 「不胀气」, no anti-colic, cure, relief, digestion or air-intake claim, and no mechanism caption that implies a health result
no doctor, hospital, midwife, laboratory or professional endorsement, and no breastfeeding-equivalence or parenting-emotion wording such as 「像喝母乳一样」 or 「每一口都是爱」
no age indication: no 「新生儿」, no 「宝宝专用」, no month or year range and no suitability statement about a child
no material-grade claim: no glass, borosilicate, 中硼硅, PPSU, PES, silicone grade, food-grade, 食品级, 环保材质, 高纯度, 硬度高 or BPA-free wording
no sterilisation, disinfection or heat standard: no 「可消毒」, no 紫外线消毒, no 蒸汽消毒, no 「耐高温」, no Celsius or Fahrenheit figures and no cycle counts
no lifespan, warranty or durability figure: no years, no usage cycles and no 「使用寿命」 statement
no origin, heritage or manufacturer claim: no 「进口」, no 「来自中国」, no 「始于1892」, no 「百年工艺」, no factory, supplier or 厂家 wording
no certification mark, test report, inspection seal, award, registration or filing number, and no comparison bar chart carrying invented values, multiples or percentages
no invented numbers anywhere: no capacity in millilitres, no dimensions in millimetres or centimetres, no pack count, piece count, shelf life, price, discount, coupon or delivery-time figure
no brand name, store name, logo, watermark, QR code, 「加入会员」 membership corner or platform badge
no infant face and no bottle at a child's mouth: any child appears only from behind or cropped above the jaw and is always held and supervised by an anonymous adult framed from the shoulder down
no loose, unsecured, detached or floating nipple or collar ring: the teat always stays seated inside the closed dome, and no microwave, no steam and no hot liquid touching skin anywhere in the set

no colour palette drift: no coral-pink, sky-aqua, mint, beige-gold, dark, wood or metallic fields, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting and no mismatched icon styles between screens
style.presentationRules: the bottle stands upright at a stable scale inside the arched niche with the tall clear egg-shaped dome fitted, the wide collar ring screwed closed and the teat fully seated inside the dome; the bell-shaped frosted milk-white body, the smoky grey-brown shoulder band directly under the collar ring, the lilac vent disc visible beneath the teat flange, the original dome height, shoulder flare and rounded base are never redrawn; any graduation or scale marking visible in the reference stays exactly as shot and is never added or removed; the label area always reads as one blank legible field with no redrawn wording; the product never floats, always keeps its contact shadow, vertical lines stay vertical, one real object anchors scale inside scene shots, and the product is never occluded by props
style.surfaceSystem: matte limewash porcelain-lilac slab with a fine chalky tooth and a sharp top edge, one short soft contact shadow under the rounded base, a faint lotus-dust #E6D9DF bounce on the shadow side and refracted edges of the arch visible through the clear dome, no mirror reflection and no wet floor
style.typography: one modern light-to-medium Chinese sans family; a single short headline in deep ink-plum #3B3444 with one soft iris-violet #8A72AE highlighter band sitting behind exactly one keyword of that headline; every section title is fronted by one small filled square bullet and followed by one full-width hairline rule; one right-aligned three-dot pagination marker, two hollow and one filled, sits under section titles; one short sub-line of copy only, no Latin overprint words, no dense body text, no mixed fonts
